cards.name: Draining Whelk
cards.oracleText:
Flash
Flying
When this creature enters, counter target spell. Put X +1/+1 counters on this creature, where X is that spell's mana value.

cards.name: Drain Life
cards.oracleText:
Spend only black mana on X.
Drain Life deals X damage to any target. You gain life equal to the damage dealt, but not more life than the player's life total before the damage was dealt, the planeswalker's loyalty before the damage was dealt, or the creature's toughness.

cards.name: Drain Power
cards.oracleText: Target player activates a mana ability of each land they control. Then that player loses all unspent mana and you add the mana lost this way.

cards.name: Drain the Well
cards.oracleText: Destroy target land. You gain 2 life.

cards.name: Drider
cards.oracleText:
Reach
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a 2/1 black Spider creature token with menace and reach.

cards.name: Drainpipe Vermin
cards.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may pay {B}. If you do, target player discards a card.
